reviews.title: Disappointed with inconsistent customer…
reviews.body:
Disappointed with inconsistent customer service

On 13 October, I changed my Lebara plan from 15GB for £6.95 to the Uswitch exclusive 50GB plan for £7.95. My son was on the same 15GB plan, but when he contacted Lebara today to request the same change, the chat agent told him it wasn’t possible.

I’m happy with Lebara’s network coverage, but this experience has been frustrating. I don’t understand why the change was possible for me but refused for my son just three days later.

If there are different eligibility rules or the offer has changed, please explain this clearly. I would like Lebara to review his request and explain why we received different answers.
reviews.author: Janaka Abhayaratne

reviews.title: Beware of misleading promotions and…
reviews.body:
Beware of misleading promotions and repeated billing errors.
I joined Lebara on a promotional 30-day rolling contract that was meant to last until March 2027.Sim only 15 gb.   Almost immediately in july the promotion vanished from my account, and they charged me £7.90 instead of the agreed rate. Lebara then charged me £5 just to reinstate the deal, only to repeatedly overcharge me over the following months. Each time I complained, support apologised, refunded the difference, and promised it was resolved only for the same £7.90 charge to hit my account again next month.
They eventually blamed a third-party website money savings expert for the issue. While customer service was polite, the repeated broken promises were unacceptable. I have since cancelled my plan. Save yourself the stress and look elsewhere for better deals with more honest pricing.
